verdict.rationale: Any web service, including a state business-filing portal, could publish an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only human-facing service pages, forms and live chat, plus a probe showing a JavaScript shell with no keyless HTML content. Nothing shows llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation.
